items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Murray took sick and Jimmy made a couple of records with us.

ctx.x: Anyway when we went in we had to go in the back way and we sat in the back of the band, off on the side where the waiters went back and forth in front of us. There was Trumbauer and Bix and I and I think a couple other guys. This was our first experience at hearing the band close. He didn't have that band too long, I think only a year or two.

But we were very happy to go to hear it, and then of course Jimmy came around. Murray took sick and Jimmy made a couple of records with us. Let's see I think it was the second time Danny Polo (phonetic) came and played. He made "My Pretty Girl" with us. So I didn't make a point of going around and hear too many bands, to tell you the truth. [They'd] go up to Harlem.
